claim_boundary: Governance override enforces machine-checkable traceability and role authorization for policy exceptions; it does not demonstrate that human decisions reflect objective ground truth or semantic correctness.

override_id.description: Unique deterministic identifier for the governance override record

case_id.description: Canonical vulnerability case identifier corresponding to trace

nominal_policy_priority.description: Nominal priority directly evaluated via Equation 8 without perturbation

pre_override_priority.description: Priority state of record immediately prior to override application

post_override_priority.description: Final operational priority resulting from authorized governance action

override_requested.description: Indicates whether a priority override request was formally initiated

override_applied.description: Flag confirming that the override has met all invariants and been formally applied

reason_code.description: Normative justification token mandatory when override_applied is true

reason_text_optional.description: Optional contextual rationale; mandatory minimum 30 characters when code is OTHER_REQUIRES_DOCUMENTED_JUSTIFICATION

evidence_ids.description: Array of evidence link or control IDs supporting the override

authorization_state.description: Lifecycle state of governance authorization request

authorized_by_role.description: Role-based authorization token preserving double-blind evaluation standards

authorization_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of formal role authorization

review_required.description: Flag indicating that manual human review or verification remains outstanding

trace_link.description: Path or URI linking governance record to the primary evidence trace

schema_version.description: Semantic version of governance override contract specification

invariants.name: explicit_request_and_approval_prerequisite
invariants.rule: override_applied == true requires (override_requested == true && authorization_state == 'APPROVED' && authorized_by_role != null)

invariants.name: nominal_preservation
invariants.rule: nominal_policy_priority must always be preserved and match Equation 8 evaluation

invariants.name: mandatory_justification_and_evidence
invariants.rule: override_applied == true requires (reason_code in reason_codes && len(evidence_ids) >= 1)

invariants.name: separation_of_roles_no_self_authorization
invariants.rule: requester role cannot match authorized_by_role; autonomous watchers cannot self-authorize

invariants.name: no_autonomous_override_by_scorer
invariants.rule: core scorer cannot autonomously apply override without external governance dispatch

invariants.name: formula_immutability
invariants.rule: Equation 8 weights and formula structure remain invariant; delta_audit term is prohibited

invariants.name: no_silent_override
invariants.rule: pre_override_priority and post_override_priority must be explicitly recorded in trace

invariants.name: fail_closed_on_malformed_or_unauthorized
invariants.rule: any contract violation forces override_applied = false, post_override_priority = nominal_policy_priority, review_required = true
